description: Consolidated four-panel summary of the four analytical arms, built from the persisted result tables
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p = "/agent/jobs/b3121cbc-4a4c-4f90-8982-3320a3dc8c81/provenance"

ne  = pd.read_csv(p+"/neighbour_enrichment.csv")
ne1 = ne[ne.threshold==">=1"].copy()
idj = pd.read_csv(p+"/g1pdh_identity_context_joined.csv")
idj["ara_context"] = idj["ara_context"].astype(bool)
ar  = pd.read_csv(p+"/arar_operator_scan.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 9))

a = ax[0,0]
lab = {"araABD":"araA/B/D","arabinase":"arabinan\ndegradation","HADphos":"HAD\nphosphatase",
       "sugarABC":"sugar ABC\ntransporter","sugarReg":"sugar\nregulator","xylose":"xylose/\nxylulose","pcrB":"pcrB"}
ne1 = ne1.set_index("category").loc[list(lab)].reset_index()
x = np.arange(len(ne1))
a.bar(x-0.2, ne1.observed, 0.4, color="#2b6cb0", label="observed")
a.bar(x+0.2, ne1.expected, 0.4, color="#bbbbbb", label="random-locus null")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels([lab[c] for c in ne1.category], fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("loci with the feature within 5 CDS (of 67)")
a.set_title("A  Genomic neighbours of G1P dehydrogenase (K00096)\nin 60 Bacillota genomes", fontsize=10)
a.legend(fontsize=8)
for xi, o, e in zip(x, ne1.observed, ne1.expected):
    if e > 0 and o > 0: a.text(xi, max(o,e)+0.8, f"{o/e:.0f}x", ha="center", fontsize=7)

b = ax[0,1]
g1 = idj.loc[idj.ara_context, "pct_id_to_BSU28760"]
g0 = idj.loc[~idj.ara_context, "pct_id_to_BSU28760"]
b.hist([g1, g0], bins=np.arange(20, 76, 3), stacked=True,
       color=["#2b6cb0","#d9d9d9"], label=["in arabinose context","no arabinose context"])
b.axvline(35, color="crimson", ls="--", lw=1)
b.text(35.8, b.get_ylim()[1]*0.8, "35 %", color="crimson", fontsize=8)
b.set_xlabel("global identity to B. subtilis AraM (%)"); b.set_ylabel("loci")
b.set_title("B  Close orthologs carry the arabinose context,\ndivergent family members never do", fontsize=10)
b.legend(fontsize=8)

c = ax[1,0]
names = ["DHAP", "NADH", "NAD+", "G1P"]
ratio = [0.37e-3/8.1e-6, 8.3e-5/16e-6, 2.6e-3/59.3e-6, 6e-6/1370e-6]
c.bar(names, ratio, color=["#2b6cb0"]*3+["#c53030"])
c.set_yscale("log"); c.axhline(1, color="k", lw=0.8)
c.set_ylabel("[metabolite] / Km   (log scale)")
c.set_title("C  Substrates of the reductive direction are saturating,\nG1P is 228-fold below its Km", fontsize=10)
for i, r in enumerate(ratio): c.text(i, r*1.5, f"{r:.3g}x", ha="center", fontsize=8)

d = ax[1,1]
d.vlines(ar.position/1e6, 0, ar.match, color="#2b6cb0", lw=2)
d.scatter(ar.position/1e6, ar.match, color="#2b6cb0", zorder=3)
d.axhline(12, color="grey", ls=":", lw=1)
genes = {"araA":2.94896,"araB":2.94748,"araD":2.94593,"araL":2.94479,
         "araM":2.94362,"araN":2.94226,"abnA":2.95017}
for gname, gp in genes.items():
    d.axvline(gp, color="#aaaaaa", lw=0.6)
    d.text(gp, 15.2, gname, rotation=90, fontsize=7, ha="center", va="bottom")
d.annotate("operon promoter\n(PMID 9084180)", xy=(2.948961, 14), xytext=(2.9430, 10.0),
           fontsize=7, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8))
d.set_ylim(0, 17); d.set_xlabel("position on NC_000964.3 (Mb)")
d.set_ylabel("best match to the 16 bp AraR palindrome")
d.set_title("D  No AraR operator upstream of araM;\nall matches cluster at the known promoter", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("ara_context loci:", int(idj.ara_context.sum()), "of", len(idj))
print("median identity, ara context:", round(g1.median(),1), " other:", round(g0.median(),1))
